name: Baikonur Site 1/5 (Gagarin's Start)
best_known_for: Sputnik 1 (1957). Vostok 1 — Gagarin (1961). Five hundred and forty Soyuz launches from a single pad.
credit: Soviet R-7 era pad at Baikonur Cosmodrome. Sputnik 1 (October 4, 1957), Vostok 1 (Gagarin, April 12, 1961), every Vostok crewed flight, every Voskhod, and the bulk of the Soyuz manifest through to the final crew launch on September 25, 2019 (Soyuz MS-15). Decommissioned for refurbishment to Soyuz-2.1a; restoration funded but timeline uncertain. Coordinates from Roscosmos and US Naval Observatory records.
